provenance: Built only from public data: ITU-R P.2040-3 Table 3 material permittivity/conductivity coefficients (values read from the MathWorks buildingMaterialPermittivity reference page reproducing that table; the ITU PDF itself was not accessed). absorption_db is the one-way transmission loss and reflection the reflection magnitude of a single homogeneous slab at normal incidence (Balanis, Advanced Engineering Electromagnetics, multiple-reflection slab formula) evaluated at the band reference frequencies 2.45/5.5/6.5 GHz. Reference thicknesses are typical-construction ASSUMPTIONS, not measurements; they are adjustable by defining a custom material. A unit test recomputes every absorption/reflection value from the p2040 parameters.
